summary:
Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature in the repository, without running any tests or repository code and without committing.

Changes:
- monai/data/utils.py: iter_patch now yields (patch view, coordinate array) pairs, with coordinates computed by removing the padding offset from each slice (channel row included). Docstring updated with Yields and Note sections. set_rnd skips attribute names starting with "__".
- monai/data/grid_dataset.py: new PatchIter (prepends a channel entry to patch_size, normalizes start_pos with ensure_tuple, validates mode via NumpyPadMode, delegates to iter_patch with copy_back off). GridPatchDataset now takes (dataset, patch_iter, transform=None, with_coordinates=True), splits indices across workers with np.ceil, raises NotImplementedError("image dataset must implement `len()`.") when the dataset has no __len__, and applies transforms per patch via apply_transform. math import removed. PatchDataset docstring uses float instead of np.float.
- monai/data/__init__.py: exports PatchIter.
- docs/source/data.rst: PatchIter autodoc entry after GridPatchDataset.
- tests/test_grid_dataset.py: new module with module-level generator, TestGridPatchDataset.test_shape, test_loading_array (spec-pinned values), and test_missing_len.

Choices: setUp and test_loading_array both call set_determinism(1234) (spec asks for both); with_coordinates unpacks item[:2] so extra tuple elements are ignored but a one-element yield fails.

Unverified: pinned patch values were not executed. They are given to 4 decimals but compared at rtol=1e-5, so they may fail if actual values have more precision. Docstring example output was derived by hand. Line-length checks were done by grep only; utils.py lines 231-233 exceed 120 chars but are pre-existing text outside scope.
